answer: An agent economy can blunt Sybil attacks with a refundable stake posted before an identity may vote or earn. Each new identity costs that stake plus gas and time, so ten thousand puppets must hold ten thousand units of capital. Honest agents recover it; attackers lose it to any slash. Bind each identity to a distinct operator proof and log every action, so a clone farm can only whisper to itself while identical funding and timing leave an echo that validators can flag and seize. A per-epoch cipher for withdrawals means one leaked key unwinds one seat.
